GitHub and PyPI have implemented new time-based defenses in their dependency management systems to combat supply chain attacks. These measures include a default three-day cooldown for new package updates on GitHub and a 14-day cutoff for uploading files to package releases on PyPI, aimed at reducing the risk of incorporating malicious code.

 - GitHub's Dependabot now includes a default three-day cooldown setting to prevent the adoption of potentially malicious packages.
 - PyPI has introduced a 14-day cutoff for adding new files to existing releases to prevent release poisoning attacks.

Source: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/github-pypi-add-time-absed-defenses-against-supply-chain-attacks/
